resources.string: Connect IMG and ISO images to your computer as a USB drive or CD-ROM.\n\nRoot is required. Set up access, image storage and USB first.
Allow USBDroid in KernelSU or Magisk. Magisk may show a permission prompt; in KernelSU, enable access in the Superuser list. USB hosting also requires kernel Mass Storage support.
Notifications show operation progress and an eject button. Select a folder through Android to grant file access.
Notifications and folder selection are optional. You can keep images in the app folder.
USB image hosting requires root. Allow USBDroid access in KernelSU or Magisk, then retry.
